description.short_caption: Erythematous swelling with vesicular lesions on the distal finger.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the distal phalanx of a finger with erythematous swelling and multiple small vesicular lesions scattered across the surface. The lesions appear translucent to slightly yellowish, and the surrounding skin is mildly inflamed. The nail is partially visible, and there is no obvious purulent discharge. The background is a neutral medical drape.
visible_findings: erythematous swelling of the distal finger

description.short_caption: Inflamed and swollen distal finger with nail bed involvement.
description.detailed_description: This image shows the distal phalanx of a finger with significant swelling, erythema, and discoloration. The nail bed appears to be partially lifted, with visible subungual hemorrhage and crusting. The surrounding tissue is erythematous and edematous, suggesting an inflammatory or infectious process. The lesion is localized to the fingertip and nail bed.
